```{r import plotting data}
# Read in & tag
mp <- read_tsv("variant_classes_summed_counts.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Graph = "MP")
cc <- read_tsv("../Calculate_per_bubble_stats_for_the_CC_graph_from_deconstructed_graph/variant_classes_summed_counts.tsv") %>%
  mutate(Graph = "CC")

# Summarize to one row per ClassMix × Graph × ALT_Count_Group
df <- bind_rows(mp, cc) %>%
  group_by(ClassMix, Graph, ALT_Count_Group) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# Factor in the correct order
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ClassMix        = factor(ClassMix, levels = c("SNV","INDEL","MNV")),
    Graph           = factor(Graph,    levels = c("MP","CC")),
    ALT_Count_Group = factor(ALT_Count_Group,
                             levels = c("2 alleles","3 alleles",">3 alleles"))
  )

# Compute x-center for MP vs CC bars
bar_w <- 0.45
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    xmid = as.numeric(ClassMix) + ifelse(Graph=="MP", -bar_w/2, +bar_w/2)
  )

# Compute stacked ymin/ymax
df <- df %>%
  arrange(ClassMix, Graph, ALT_Count_Group) %>%
  group_by(ClassMix, Graph) %>%
  mutate(
    ymin = lag(cumsum(n), default = 0),
    ymax = cumsum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r table}
df
```

```{r plot, include=TRUE, fig.width=3.66666666667, fig.height=2.66666666667}
# Draw with geom_rect()
ggplot(df) +
  geom_rect(aes(
    xmin = xmid - bar_w/2,
    xmax = xmid + bar_w/2,
    ymin = ymin / 1e6,
    ymax = ymax / 1e6,
    fill = ALT_Count_Group
  ), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:3,
    labels = c("SNV","INDEL","MNV"),
    expand = c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0,0),
    limits = c(0, 42)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    breaks = c("2 alleles","3 alleles",">3 alleles"),
    values = c(
      "2 alleles"  = "#b96f7450",
      "3 alleles"  = "#b96f74B0",
      ">3 alleles" = "#b96f74"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression("Variant sites"~"(×10"^6*")")
  ) +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") -> p1

p1
```
